reference.author: Prototype example authors
reference.description: Synthetic requirements and explicitly specified reference formulas for exercising mutation tooling. Not observed engineering defects or independently validated system requirements.

requirements.text: When a START command is present, an acknowledgement shall be present.
When operating mode is enabled, motion shall be enabled.
The selected channel index shall equal 2.
The battery voltage shall be at most 28 V.

variants.eligibility: A Boolean implication states the required response.
variants.rationale: Remove the required response without asserting its opposite.
variants.text: A START command imposes no acknowledgement obligation.

variants.eligibility: The requirement has an explicit operating-mode antecedent.
variants.rationale: Deleting this applicability guard makes its consequence unconditional.

variants.eligibility: The equality uses an explicit integer value.
variants.rationale: Replace the required setting while retaining its variable and type.
variants.text: The selected channel index shall equal 3.

variants.eligibility: The requirement uses an upper bound with an explicit voltage value.
variants.rationale: Raise the upper limit by one canonical volt.
variants.text: The battery voltage shall be at most 29 V.

variants.eligibility: The same condition and required response can be paraphrased.
variants.rationale: Double negation preserves the complete formal expression.

variants.eligibility: The same applicability relation can be restated.

variants.text: Motion shall be enabled whenever operating mode is enabled.
